# SkyrimNet_DOM

> SkyrimNet ↔ Diary of Mine bridge (with SkyrimNet_SexLab). Papyrus + DOMSlave YAML + prompts + items. LLM content ships as `goodprovider.dom`.

## Read by job

| Job | Start here |
|-----|------------|
| Player / FAQ / install | docs/players/overview.md, docs/players/requirements.md |
| Author actions | docs/authors/actions.md |
| Author prompts | docs/authors/prompts.md + docs/reference/{json-keys,protocol-tokens}.md |
| Author events / punishment / content | docs/authors/events.md, docs/authors/punishment.md, docs/authors/content.md |
| Develop Papyrus | docs/developers/papyrus.md, docs/reference/papyrus-rules.md |
| Player WebUI (SexLab overlay) | docs/players/overview.md, manifest/DOM.md |
| Agent policy | AGENTS.md (safety, confidence, commits) |
| Quirks | KNOWLEDGEBASE.md |
| Release documentation | release-guide.xml, release-checkpoint.xml |
| Changelog | CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG-user.md |
| Short examples | Prefer snippets pointing at SKSE/Plugins/... shipped files |

## Optional examples (in-tree)

- Action YAML: SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/external/goodprovider.dom/actions/DOMSlave_Sex_Two_Fucking.yaml
- Punishment map: SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet_DOM/punishment_reason.json
- Item YAML: SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/config/items/diaryofmine_EB8659.yaml

## Do not ingest (unless debugging that area)

- SSEEdit Cache/
- versions/
- Source copy/, Headers_Source/, fomod-source copy/, release-guide copy.xml
- review-*.xml, review_*.md, reviews/, z-plan.md, punishment_checkpoint.xml
- crashlog.txt, crash-*.log, Papyrus.0.log
- *.refcache

## Compile reminders

- Papyrus: Cursor task `compile: pyro` / `skyrimse.ppj` (preferred)
- SKSE plugin: `SKSE_Source` CMake `--preset release` (`SkyrimNet_DOM.dll`)
- Packaging: `make release` (maintainer-owned; see release-guide.xml)
